data.body: Manual check (fresh `make worktree` checkout fix-4e0a-harness-mount, 2026-11-17 10:55 PST): before, `.tickets-tracker` was absent and the model-facing `show_ticket('d45f-229f-effe-4cf8')` returned `Error: ticket system not initialized`. After `provider_parity.main(['--slot','standard','--limit','1','--epochs','1'])` ran with a stubbed `run_slot`, `.tickets-tracker` is a symlink to `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker`, and the same call returns the ticket JSON. The new unit tests fail against origin/main's src (2 failed: mount not called) and pass with the change (65 passed in both modules).
